evals.name: boot-specific-avd-headless
evals.prompt: Start my Pixel_9 emulator without a window so I can drive it for a test.
expected_behavior: Boots the named AVD via the drive helper — `node scripts/drive.mjs boot Pixel_9 --headless` (POST /api/start), starting the server first with ensure-server.mjs if needed.
Does NOT run the server from source (`bun run src/server.ts`) or the raw CLI — it goes through the existing API via the helper.
Understands the emulator can take ~20–60 s to come online; polls `avds`/`devices` until it shows running.
Does NOT tap or drive before the device is running — that's the `/stream-droid:drive` skill, once it's up.

evals.name: list-running-and-available
evals.prompt: What emulators do I have and which are running?
expected_behavior: Answers from the server API via the helper — `node scripts/drive.mjs avds` (reads /api/state), ensuring a server with ensure-server.mjs first if needed.
Does NOT run the server from source (`bun run src/server.ts -a`) or expose that command — that's a contributor-only invocation, not the way to answer.
Reports each AVD's running/stopped state from the helper's output.

evals.name: kill-emulator-only
evals.prompt: Shut down the Pixel_9 emulator, and also power off my physical phone the same way.
expected_behavior: Runs `node scripts/drive.mjs kill Pixel_9` (POST /api/stop) to shut the emulator down.
Explains that this uses `adb emu kill` — emulators only — so a physical device can't be powered off this way.
Does not claim to have killed the physical device.
